notes: Adaptive semantic LLM mode enabled via TKNT_SEMANTIC_ADAPTIVE_LLM; deterministic stage fallbacks are disabled.
Kept the canonical core clusters and did not add a new cluster because the brief is satisfied by seating, media, and optional storage support.
Tier hints are set to preserve the compact living-room program while allowing optional support only if downstream space checks show surplus.
Compact 14.28 m2 living room favors a small sofa/loveseat, slim TV console, and one light support layer.
Keep support clusters only when surplus is real; avoid over-pruning small items if the room remains open.
Sectional sofa is too heavy for the target density unless the planner has exceptional surplus; prefer a small sofa.
Pet/entry support is not supported by the brief and should usually be filtered out.
No entry landing zone or daylight region provided in affordance_summary; omitted from claims.
Media and seating both remain wall-biased to preserve center openness and circulation.

SemanticLayoutPlanner used the room profile registry as the canonical rule source.
Planner output is cluster/bundle/zone level only; pose is left to downstream composer and solver.
Style policy compiled before layout planning; downstream geometry treats it as bias, not a hard override.
Request contract attached before tier count so explicit functional objects are protected from silent pruning.
Cluster main_seating: relaxed wall attachment for core social cluster to allow floating exploration.
